name: research
title: Research board
summary: Research you can cite: every claim traced back to its source.

rules.text: Every claim in a finding links to its source.
rules.why: a claim without a source cannot be checked.

rules.text: A finding counts only after a second agent rechecks its source.
rules.why: the first reader rarely catches its own misreading.

items.title: Every claim in a finding links to its source
items.criterion: Every claim in the findings folder carries a link to its source. test/finding-sources.test.js reads each finding, fails on a claim without a link, and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- findings/ (one claim per bullet)
- test/finding-sources.test.js
Test:
- test/finding-sources.test.js reads every finding and fails on a claim bullet without a link
